title: Fix the two console defects a tenant administrator sees on every page: platform-capability misjudgement and a department tree that renders only its root
goal: Two console defects survive every acceptance run and are the first thing a tenant administrator notices. TenantViewpointSwitcher decides whether the caller is platform-capable with hasPerm('system:tenant:list'); a tenant administrator holds the full console key set including that key, so every page load fires GET /system/tenant/list, gets 403 tenant.platformOnly, and the global interceptor shows two red toasts (StrictMode double-invokes in dev). DeptList hands the nested tree to Arco Table with pagination.total = data.length and no expandable/childrenColumnName, so only the root department renders and the page reports a total of 1 while the API returns a two-level tree. Both are wrong decision inputs, not styling: one needs a real capability signal, the other needs the already-computed flatDeptRows or a tree-shaped table.
findings: F5 (P1): TenantViewpointSwitcher proxies platform capability with a permission key the tenant admin legitimately holds, so every console page issues GET /system/tenant/list and shows two 403 tenant.platformOnly toasts.
F6 (P1): DeptList binds the nested tree directly to the table without expandable/childrenColumnName, so only the root department renders and the total reads 1 instead of the real department count.

out: Changing the tenant switch API or its 403 semantics
Redesigning the department page layout or the org tab

implementationNotes: Use a real platform signal for F5: tenantId === 0 or resolvedBy === 'platform-fallback' from /auth/tenants/current, which the switcher already has access to. A permission key is an authorization fact, not a scope fact.

Alternative if the signal is not available at that point: keep the call but route it through a silent channel that does not raise a global toast. Prefer the capability signal; suppressing the symptom leaves the wrong request in place.

For F6, prefer binding flatDeptRows (already computed in the file) with total = flatDeptRows.length so search, sort and pagination keep working; switching to Arco's tree mode is acceptable only if the surrounding toolbar still behaves.
Both fixes are covered by existing smoke specs; extend rather than add new spec files.

humanGates: Confirm the preferred capability signal for the viewpoint switcher (tenantId === 0 vs resolvedBy), since the two differ for a platform user operating inside a tenant.
completionChecklist: No tenant.platformOnly toast on any console page for a tenant admin
